alerts.headline: Small Craft Advisory issued September 28 at 2:15PM EDT until September 28 at 8:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Nantucket Sound; Vineyard Sound; Buzzards Bay
alerts.description: * WHAT...Southeast winds 5 to 10 kt and seas 2 to 4 feet. * WHERE...Nantucket Sound, Vineyard Sound and Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...Until 8 PM EDT this evening. * IMPACTS...Conditions will be hazardous to small craft.
alerts.instruction: Inexperienced mariners, especially those operating smaller vessels, should avoid navigating in hazardous conditions.

alerts.headline: Coastal Flood Statement issued September 28 at 2:08PM EDT until September 29 at 12:00AM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.areas: Southern Bristol; Southern Plymouth; Southeast Providence; Eastern Kent; Bristol; Washington; Newport; Block Island
alerts.description: * WHAT...Pockets of up to one half foot of inundation above ground level in low-lying areas near shorelines and tidal waterways. * WHERE...In Rhode Island, areas along Narragansett Bay as well as south coastal areas. In Massachusetts, south coastal areas along Buzzards Bay. * WHEN...Until midnight EDT tonight. * IMPACTS...Some water on low lying roads and property.
alerts.instruction: Do not drive through flooded roadways.

alerts.headline: Flood Warning issued September 28 at 11:23AM EDT until September 29 at 6:00PM EDT by NWS Boston/Norton MA
alerts.description: ...The Flood Warning continues for the following rivers in Massachusetts... Taunton River Near Bridgewater affecting Bristol and Plymouth Counties. alerts.instruction: Motorists should not attempt to drive around barricades or drive cars through flooded areas. Additional information is available at www.weather.gov. The next statement will be issued this evening at 1130 PM EDT.
